recap_subtitle: Step into the magical third dimension, future game designers! Let's review the exciting 3D spaces, gravity physics, and camera actions we coded to build realistic virtual worlds. The 12 sessions are summarized below:

sessions.title: Session 1: Introduction to 3D and XR Space
targets: Identify VR and XR game concepts
sessions.project: Constructing our first 3D scene with geometric shapes and cameras!

sessions.title: Session 2: 2D vs 3D Workspace & Cameras
sessions.project: Camera sweep animations! Creating a moving camera view around our 3D stage.

sessions.title: Session 3: Enabling 3D Physics & Collisions
sessions.project: Bouncy Cubes! Activating physics on boxes so they bounce, fall, and hit the stage realisticly!

sessions.title: Session 4: Gravity & Applied Forces
targets: Apply active push forces to objects
sessions.project: Bouncing slopes! Applying physical impulses to slide balls down inclined structures.

sessions.title: Session 5: The Rube Goldberg Machine
sessions.project: Rube Goldberg Machine - A chain reaction where falling balls push dominoes and trigger switches!

sessions.title: Session 6: Drive 3D Car in City
targets: Lock camera views to follow moving cars
sessions.project: 3D Car Simulator - Drive a car through a virtual city, turning around borders with following cameras!

sessions.title: Session 7: Building the 3D Solar System
blocks: orbit around target X Y Z
sessions.project: 3D Solar System - Modeling all planets revolving around the central glowing Sun with authentic speeds!

sessions.title: Session 8: Lights, Lighting & Letter Glows
targets: Adjust light glow colors and intensities
blocks: add point light at X Y Z
sessions.project: Glowing Letters - Illuminating the academy logo using colored point lights placed on front panels!

sessions.title: Session 9: 3D Duck Hunt - Shoot Bullets
blocks: set bullet velocity X Y Z
sessions.project: Aim and Fire! Cording the ability to spawn and launch 3D sphere projectiles when clicking the mouse!

sessions.title: Session 10: 3D Duck Hunt - Duck Deaths & Clones
targets: Use broadcast signals to trigger hits
sessions.project: Duck Hunter Actions - Making target ducks fall down realisticly and disappear when struck by bullets!

sessions.title: Session 11: 3D UI & Overlay Launch Screens
targets: Design 2D overlay UI elements on 3D stages
sessions.project: Game HUD - Crafting professional health labels and score displays on top of the 3D game camera!

sessions.title: Session 12: Sound Waves & Final Polish
targets: Understand sound waves in gaming atmospheres
Add hit sounds and winning victory tunes
sessions.project: Polished Duck Hunter - Adding background tracks, laser blasts, and victory chimes to complete our 3D game!
